intents.description: Current outdoor weather: temperature, sky condition, humidity right now.
Past outdoor weather: yesterday, this morning, earlier today, or any prior point.
examples: how was it outside this morning
what did the weather do earlier

intents.description: Forecast for tomorrow or the rest of today: rain, temperature, storm warnings.
Current indoor conditions: temperature, humidity, air quality, eCO2 right now.
examples: how humid is it in here

intents.description: Past indoor conditions over the last 24 hours: max/min temp, humidity, peak air quality.
examples: what was the highest temperature today
how did the room change today

intents.description: Coach metrics: room readiness for focus, recovery score for rest, air strain score.
examples: is the room good for focus
is this a good place to sleep

intents.description: Actionable suggestion based on current conditions: open window, humidify, ventilate, rest.
examples: is it time to take a break

intents.description: Off-topic, ambiguous, or anything the snapshot cannot answer. Triggers a generic deflection.
